property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and a callee that successfully handles transferFrom calls, C.transfer always returns true; the mutant returns false, so there exist inputs (any valid call) where the return value differs.

For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, the reference contract's transfer(...) always returns true (never returns false) when the call does not revert; the mutant can return false if an internal low-level call to the callee returns false for any element, so there exist inputs (a callee that returns false for some target) causing the mutant to return false while the reference still yields true.

For any non-empty _tos array and any callee, the original C.transfer never returns false when the external low-level calls do not revert (it always returns true for completed calls); the mutant can return false when a callee's low-level call returns false for some element — so there exists a callee contract that makes a low-level call return false and thus breaks the rule.

For any non-empty _tos array and any callee, the reference C.transfer(...) never returns false when all low-level calls complete (it always returns true for a completed call); the mutant can return false if a callee's low-level call returns false for some element, so there exists a callee (that returns false on its fallback) that makes the mutant return false while the reference still returns true.
